newsitem.title: USA: OHM sees second half gain from litigation.
newsitem.headline: OHM sees second half gain from litigation.

text.p: OHM Corp said Tuesday it expects to realize a net $12 million cash in the second half in connection with the settlement of certain claims and litigation.
The company said in a statement it also expects its contract backlog to increase in the second half from the $1.7 billion at the end of the first half.

"We currently have outstanding about $1.2 billion in bids for projects, the majority for DOE (Department of Energy) facilities, and we expect to submit bids for a significant number of additional opportunities in the second half of the year," it said.
OHM, which manages environmental clean-up projects, reported an operating profit of $0.12 per share for the second quarter, up from $0.09 for the same period a year ago.
